title: Daily Brain Memory Ledger, Vault Snapshot CLI, and Teacher-Guided ML Trading Domain Contracts
public_summary: Implement structured Daily Brain Memory JSONL storage with anti-leakage and secret guardrails, snapshot packing into Google Drive Vault categories, and domain-isolated JSON contracts for owner-taught ML trading where LLM translates NL to JSON only.
inputs: Owner architecture approval: store lightweight sanitized daily JSONL logs under workflows/memory/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl in Git and pack snapshots via vault_sync.py into state_snapshots

Owner constraint: keep specific market, timeframe, and teaching strategy rules deferred until owner teaching sessions; LLM must act strictly as NL <-> JSON translator and never execute trades or bypass risk gates
Existing storage/vault infrastructure (python/alpha_mining/storage/vault.py) and 5 domain boundary modules (research, strategy, risk, execution, accounting)
outputs: Domain contract skeletons: research/contracts.py, strategy/contracts.py, risk/contracts.py, execution/contracts.py, accounting/contracts.py + backward-compatible __init__.py exports
workflows/memory/README.md + initial sanitized governance episode log under workflows/memory/
Unit tests in python/tests/test_brain_memory.py and python/tests/test_domain_contracts.py
constraints: Preserve all existing dataclasses and passing tests in python/tests/ without breaking backward compatibility
Use Python 3.11 standard library only (no third-party dependencies in runtime or tests)
Enforce lookahead invariance: resolved BrainEpisode outcomes must satisfy outcome_at_utc >= observed_at_utc, and resolving pending episodes cannot mutate features/context/translation retroactively
Enforce secret sanitization on all BrainEpisode records written under workflows/memory/
Enforce translator isolation (translator_role == 'nl_to_json_only') and deterministic risk gating before ExecutionOrderRequest creation
Never modify governance charters (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, roles/) or fabricate live trading alpha claims
assumptions: Market instrument, timeframe, and primary strategy rules remain deferred pending Owner teaching sessions and will require dedicated quant_research ConditioningBriefs in Phase 2
Remote Drive push/pull automation awaits Owner configuring RCLONE_CONFIG_GDRIVE OAuth secret; local snapshot packing uses existing vault.py state_snapshot pipeline
acceptance_criteria: alpha-ovca validate-brief and verify-stream pass on workflows/runs/wf-brain-memory-001/
All new and existing Python unittests, Rust fmt/check/test/clippy --locked, ruleset validation, and admission policy parity checks pass cleanly
scripts/brain_memory.py validate passes on workflows/memory/ and deterministic snapshot round-trip passes checksum verification
Independent adversarial code audit catches zero critical or high-severity flaws and PR #7 passes CI + OVCA Reviewer Bot

authority.objective: Build Daily Brain Memory storage/snapshot tooling and domain-neutral contracts for owner-taught ML trading on a clean feature branch
constraints: Keep PR strictly bounded to approved scope; do not merge or alter governance files
